{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reuse df_clean from previous step

# Re-run the stratified analysis to ensure full output is printed
# Include detailed cross-tabulation with counts

# Cross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment with counts
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs. customer_segment (with counts):')
ct = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment'], margins=True)
print(ct)

# Stratified conversion rates
print('\nStratified conversion rates by segment and channel:')
df_stratified = df_clean.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print(df_stratified)

# Compute within-segment differences
print('\nWithin-segment differences in conversion rate (email - paid_search):')
differences = []
for seg in df_clean['customer_segment'].unique():
    seg_data = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == seg]
    if len(seg_data['channel'].unique()) < 2:
        continue
    rate_email = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    rate_paid = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = rate_email - rate_paid
    differences.append({
        'segment': seg,
        'email_rate': rate_email,
        'paid_search_rate': rate_paid,
        'difference': diff
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
diff_df = pd.DataFrame(differences)
print(diff_df)

# Summary of overall and stratified comparisons
overall_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
overall_paid = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
print(f'\nOverall conversion rate difference (email - paid_search): {overall_email - overall_paid:.4f}')"}
